narration: पारो की छाया और छोटी हो गई। मटर के दाने जितनी।
caption: Paro's shadow got even smaller. No bigger than a pea.
image_brief: The cream wall with a pea-sized rabbit shadow on it, the lamp glowing right at the wall's base below.

narration: पारो चौंक जाती है। यह तो उलटा हो गया।
caption: Paro is startled. That went the wrong way.
image_brief: Paro's face with her eyebrows lifted in surprise, lit from below by the lamp lying on the bedsheet.

narration: लैंप दीवार के पास आया, तो हाथ लैंप से दूर हो गए।
caption: The lamp came near the wall, so her hands ended up far from the lamp.
image_brief: The bedroom from the side: the lamp pressed to the wall on the left, Paro's raised hands far away near her pillow on the right.

narration: हाथ रोशनी से जितने दूर, छाया उतनी ही छोटी बनती है।
caption: The farther the hands are from the light, the smaller the shadow gets.
image_brief: Paro's hands making ears while held well away from the small lamp, a little shadow on the wall beyond them.

narration: यही सबसे आम गलती है। लैंप को दीवार से चिपकाना।
caption: This is the commonest mistake. Sticking the lamp against the wall.
image_brief: The lamp's paper shade squashed flat against the plaster, a narrow band of light creeping along the wall.

narration: पारो लैंप उठाकर पीछे, दरवाज़े के पास रख देती है।
caption: Paro picks the lamp up and sets it back near the door.
image_brief: Paro walking barefoot across the floor holding the lamp toward the closed bedroom door, its wire trailing behind her.

narration: करीब चार कदम पीछे। यह गिनती अंदाज़े की है।
caption: About four steps back. That count is only a rough one.
image_brief: Paro's bare feet on the floor mid-step beside the stretched lamp wire, warm light from behind her ankles.

narration: छाया बड़ी हो गई, पर बहुत फीकी। कान दिखते ही नहीं।
caption: The shadow grew bigger, but very faint. The ears do not show at all.
image_brief: The wall carrying one large pale rabbit shape with no clear ears, the plaster barely darker where the shadow lies.

narration: दूर से रोशनी कमज़ोर पहुँचती है। पारो की दीवार धुँधली सी लगती है।
caption: From far away the light arrives weak. Paro's wall looks hazy.
image_brief: The whole bedroom in weak light, the lamp small in the far door corner, both low beds dim.

narration: पारो लैंप वापस तकिए पर लाती है। हाथ रोशनी से सटा देती है।
caption: Paro brings the lamp back to the pillow and puts her hands right against the light.
image_brief: Paro back on the bed with the lamp beside her pillow, her laced hands held so close that the glow spills around her fingers.

narration: अब पारो का खरगोश दरवाज़े जितना बड़ा है! पूरी दीवार भर गई।
caption: Now Paro's rabbit is as big as the door! The whole wall is filled.
image_brief: A huge rabbit shadow covering the cream wall from floor to ceiling, Paro tiny on the bed in front of it.

narration: पर कान गायब हैं। छाया धुँधले बादल जैसी है।
caption: But the ears have vanished. The shadow is like a blurred cloud.
image_brief: A big soft grey blob of shadow spread over the wall with no ear shapes anywhere in it.

narration: किनारे कहीं ख़त्म ही नहीं होते। छाया धुएँ की तरह फैलती है।
caption: The edges never end anywhere. The shadow spreads out like smoke.
image_brief: The corner where the wall meets the ceiling, the shadow's edge fading away into the lit plaster.

narration: पारो बिस्तर पर खड़ी होती है और हाथ ऊपर उठाती है।
caption: Paro stands up on the bed and lifts her hands high.
image_brief: Paro standing on the soft mattress with both arms raised above her head, the lamp glowing near her ankles.

narration: पारो के सिर की छाया पूरे खरगोश को निगल जाती है।
caption: The shadow of Paro's own head swallows the whole rabbit.
image_brief: A large dark shadow of Paro's head and shoulders covering the wall, only a sliver of the rabbit shape left at its side.
